content:
DiffusionGemma is our new experimental open model with up to 4x faster output on dedicated GPUs.

Instead of predicting word-by-word, it generates entire blocks of text simultaneously. This lets the model self-correct and format complex markdown in real time.
author: GoogleDeepMind
reason: 本文中に「is our new experimental open model」とあり、すでに利用可能な状態と判断しました。
title_ja: DiffusionGemma: 高速な実験的オープンモデル
summary_ja: Google DeepMindが開発した、専用GPUで最大4倍高速な出力を実現する新しい実験的オープンモデル。

title: For ongoing tasks, like planning a wedding or managing a move, Search will soon be able to build custom experiences with Google @Antigravity that you can continue to come back to and make progress on.
content:
For ongoing tasks, like planning a wedding or managing a move, Search will soon be able to build custom experiences with Google @Antigravity that you can continue to come back to and make progress on. Think of them like building your own mini apps right in Search.

Here’s @rmstein, VP of Product, Search demoing the new tool on the #GoogleIO stage.
author: Google
reason: 本文中に「Search will soon be able to build」とあり、近日公開予定と判断しました。
title_ja: Google検索によるカスタム体験構築機能
summary_ja: Google検索が、ウェディング計画など進行中のタスク向けにカスタム体験を構築する機能。
